subsystem_base_chassis_weatherproof_asa.structural_purpose: Hexagonal structural base carrier enclosure. Employs thick perimeters to house the concentric connection pathways and hollow internal elephant-ear cooling flutes securely.

subsystem_armor_layer_clear_tpu.structural_purpose: Sub-surface auxetic impact protection shield. Relies completely on parametric negative Poisson re-entrant geometric webs. Printed slowly with zero infill to allow the internal cell hinges to compress and flex naturally under impact stress loads.

subsystem_optical_skin_transparent_pmma.structural_purpose: Angle-invariant micro-prism optical capture face optimized for PMMA (Acrylic). Printed solid with fine layer spacing at steady heat with cooling fans disabled to allow the toolpath tracks to melt together into a perfectly glassy, clear structure. This maximizes light transmission, enables total internal reflection trapping, and preserves ideal thermal depolymerization recycling purity.
